title: Rory and the Amber Lantern Hills
verses:
The hills were now glowing in amber and gold,
As quiet night shadows began to unfold.
And Rory walked slowly to look at the view,
Where soft-growing mosses were damp with the dew.

Then Tilly came walking with footsteps so light,
To watch all the blossoms that glowed in the night.
And Benny lay down in the sweet-scented grass,
To wait for the bright silver planet to pass.

Now Ricky was tired from running all day,
And folded his claws as he finished his play.
Psittaco was chirping a soft little tune,
And nested in leaves by the light of the moon.

High up in the branches did Nia look down,
To watch as the shadows turned purple and brown.
She spread out her wings in a sleepy embrace,
And flew to the ground at a very slow pace.

They gathered around in a circle so deep,
While Rory was ready to drift into sleep.
The amber-bright flowers were closing their heads,
As all of the dinosaurs found their warm beds.

The stars in the sky were now shining so bright,
To give all the friends a soft blanket of light.
They closed their tired eyes as the gentle wind blew,
And slept in the forest the whole night-time through.
